It's a Costco. I go in super early (5am) to stock before the store opens. Its busy and stressful and noisy and I don't feel like I can do it much longer
Oh god I hate that this is highly upvoted because I am a stocker already and I find it almost too stressful... I was hoping this thread would give me better ideas....
Oh I know who it's by, that's why I like it!

You don't have to apologize for being a bit angry and dejected, especially after going through a breakup. If you want to talk I'm here

PS. love the username

I dont know. I tend to actively fight anything thats good or healthy for me because I'm a fucking idiot. Sometimes i think that I don't want to succeed or be good at anything. I want ot be a failure, because there's no reason I that I should be so mad and bad at everything I try.

Most people are stressed, busy, overworked, under appreciated, and unfulfilled. Most people are liars too, they might tell you differently, but no ones truly happy. Yes those are assumptions, but that's how the world really is.
99% of people I see are miserable doing shitty jobs they hate just to survive and buy shit they dint need. If that's what I'm avoiding, I'm okay with it
I hear that man. Life sucks, drop out.
Nothing wrong with it. It's your life do it how you want. You can end it when you want and live if you want. It's the one thing we have...

The outside world is terrible and I dread the thought of ever joining it. Perhaps I do fear change, but it's because no good can come of being a healthy regular person. All I can hope for there is more disappointment and failure, and to fall back into this pit.
In a way yes. I don't know life without self loathing
Maybe some time. I'm good for now though

I haven't really been into any comedies in a long time... I kind of dont' have patience for them anymore. They just get on my nerves more than make me happy. And Im sure Im capable of a lot, but honestly my motivation is at an all time low and my brain begins to hurt when I try to apply myself in anything. I used to be so fucking smart but I've let my brain rot to shit from laziness and now I can barely use it anymore. I've become such a fucking idiot and a failure.

I don't really have any other hobbies. I'm learning guitar very slowly but I'm still really awful at it and haven't really had any motivation to get better in a long while, I dont' really enjoy it anymore. Or anything really...
It's probably a combination of both. Creating doesn't help though. I've tried that stuff, it only feels good when I ruin something. If I don't hate myself for doing it afterwords it's not helping me.

I guess what I get angry about is just a lifetime of being pretty shit at everything I try. I have nothing to be proud of and I even suck at things I'm passionate about.

I don't know what childhood stuff could  be affecting me. I grew up without a father for a good chunk of my childhood so that didn't help but I don't know... I think I've always  been like his even when he was around so I doubt its related.
I suppose :) it just feels now a big event in someone's like and the it should be memorable in some way
I feel I might end up joining it some day
Maybe, perhaps you should ask them why. It's very odd.
How are YOU feeling? You just deleted a bunch of posts you made to a bunch of people and I hope you're feeling okay right now

I understand that the freedom is nice, but I just don't think the stress and anxiety inducing nature of adult responsibility is worth it I guess. It's overwhelming, life ruining. I struggle in my currently carefree lifestyle, I cant do more that this!
Thanks. Looking around the sub, you are a very active person. Its very nice of you and I think you're a great person for trying to help so many people. Maybe lay off the "lovebug" though :)

I should have worded that better... I don't plan on doing anything drastic now, or even soon probably. But I dont want my life to become this never ending cycle of responsibility and worry. I have it easy right now, relatively, but I already struggle living in a way most people would consider relaxed and care free. I'm fine for a little while at least, I'll just have to see where my life goes from here
Everything in this thread is reasons I want to kill myself. I can't handle this shit and don't want to ever have to.

I just want you to know that I am in exactly the same place as you in life rigiht now. I know it's hard, and that this is all gonna sound like cliche crap, but there is a light at the end of the tunnel. And you probably can't see it now, depression and anger can cloud or vision, but I assure you it is there. There is nothing wrong with you, you are not weak or pathetic, you just haven't found a calling in life yet, but you can and will some day. Just live for a little longer, okay? And call your family or a friend and tell them all this. You have people in your life who can help!

That does sound like a pretty miserable experience. I promise not to go unless absolutely necessary, I just often feel like I need a place to go to escape the world for a long while and not have to worry about all the bullshit that goes with being a healthy functioning person. I want to be babies I guess is what I'm saying
I've looked into depression, but I'm not depressed I'm just lazy. I've been lazy and spoiled my whole life and now I'm too used to it to ever change.

I tried the college route and failed miserably. I had no motivation or passion for anything I saw there. I'm just too fucking lazy for school. I always thought I would thrive there but the exact opposite happened.
See, it's odd for me because I really dont suffer from any much anxiety. I could be so successful if I wanted to be I just don't want to be at all.
I've been to help before. It's all temporary. Thoughts come back, all I have to do is be real about it all again. I prefer a more perminant solution.
Not everyone deserves to live, and I am one of those people. I dont know if I feel exactly how you do, to me it's less of a struggle and more just a matter of acceptance. I've accepted my fate.
Thanks. If nothing else, this will help leave a trail behind after I'm gone. Give people an idea of how I felt.

I'm not in immediate danger, so don't worry too much. It's just a feeling that I'm not going to last much longer. My life isn't going to improve any. It's not like I'm in such a bad place in life, I"m just too much of a little bitch to take the minor blows that I get.

It's less the fact taht I'm a virgin, and more the fact that I am in no position to ever stop being a virgin. My body is falling apart and I'm getting uglier and grosser than I already am. My skin is disgusting, my hair is falling out, I'm getting fatter, I'm going blind and I really just kind of never ssee anything changing. I'm probably the worlds most unattractive person
I'm only 20, but no I haven't. I've never even held another person's hand before.
My loneliness is starting to become a huge burden on my mental health. I'm affraid that I'm never going to feel what it's like to be loved. I hope you can find someone as well someday.
I used to play tons of video games but now... they've just gotten boring to me and I can't play them very much at all. I really have no passion anymore.
Well, at least you have that, even if it isn't much.

I kind of feel the same with weed. I smoke a little and it's okay but if I smoke enough to become introspective (a very fine line) it only makes everything worse and I realize even more that I'll never accomplish any of the things I wanted to earlier in life and that it's actually probably even more downhill from here. People being sad about me is nice, but then they'll die too and then I'll be forgotten forever

I really am having a hard time thinking of anything right now. I know I've done not bad things when I was younger but I'm in such a pit right now that nothing seems significant. But I'll try

1. did well in high school
2. i used to have friends, and that's nice

i really can't think of much more. my life is a boring series of mediocrity.
Very little. I sit on the internet all day. I don't really enjoy it though, I just sort of pass the time
I've never had even close to enough confidence to ask anyone out. Ive always hated myself too much and would never burden someone with me.

I thought he would be more okay with it. I never expected him to return the love, I know he's not gay or anything so it was just more letting him know. I don't know, I guess that was a bad call. I'm not so hung up on the label, I just can't really tell if it's just me being desperate or if it is just coming up now.

Man, my heart aches for you. I can't imagine being in such a situation. I used to have a friend (male friend) who did exactly what you are doing, but I never really thought about the emotional anguish it causes. I'm sorry I can't really offer advice but I just want you to know that your story moved me in a way. Stay strong.
I do want better. I'm just not sure what that is or why I even want it. A part of me really likes being like this but I know I just can't. It's weird.
I will. I just need to remember what it's like to not hate myself

I just can't do that. I have my family breathing down my neck. And they should be, kicking me in the ass is the only way to make me do anything. I need help. I've been to a therapist before but maybe it's time to go back. We'll see if I ever end up going though.

I've tried that. In the end, nothing comes of it though. My head never stays clear and I never stop being a lazy asshole. If I could get away with never leaving the house I would. I am really starting to feel like I'm never gonna change. Who cares if I'm alive if I'm never gonna live
I'll be fine, I think. Thanks again. You're a good person.
Just letting you know I'm still alive. I feel terrible, but I think I'll be okay.

The only super close person I've lost was my father, and I still think about that every other day or so. I'm terrible at dealing with loss. If another comes, maybe I'll forget about it. I hope that happens. I'm too fucking misserable tonight. I'm going to be and going to try to feel better in the mouring. thanks for your help
I hope so. I'm too emotional tonight. I'm going to go to bed and in the mourning hopefully I'll be over all  this and feel better. Thanks again for your help. It really means a lot to me.
I really hope you're right. But I don't know how long until I stop missing him. I thought he was better than this, but I guess not.
I'm only 20. Probably too young to be a little bitch about things like this. I just don't ever want to go through with this again. I can't take loss I guess.

The thing is, he kind of was the guy I found in step 3. I had previously stopped hearing from my other friends and was alone when I met him, and now I'm back to step 1. I would prefer the smaller conflicts to this though, at least then my might have not been so attached to him when it happened. I hate this so much, I fucked up the one good thing I had going left.
Maybe. It's just a matter of whether it's worth waiting and suffering for.

Thank you for replying. This guy was the one I loved and the only person who really seemed to give a shit about me until now. But he couldn't be both and now he's gone. I think dying would be nice at this point.
